admin.title: Admin
admin.login_note: Admin sign-in is not device-bound; admin accounts cannot place orders.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Print job status, accounts and effective runtime settings at a glance.
overview.auto_release_help: Off by default: payment only records the ledger; users press "Confirm print" to release paper.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Recent orders; refund or manually re-queue a print job.

backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Export and restore data.
backup.export_note: The export is a whole-site snapshot: a consistent database snapshot plus uploaded files (zip). It can be done at any time without affecting the service.
backup.restore_note: Restoring overwrites data: the uploaded backup is validated and staged first, and applied only after the service restarts; the previous data is kept as *.pre-restore.
backup.restore_help: Backups whose schema version is newer than this service are rejected.
backup.invalid: Not a valid backup file (format, manifest or schema version mismatch)
backup.staged_detail: Schema version {{version}} · staged at {{time}}; it is applied automatically after a restart.

admin.refund_reason_title: Refund (reason is logged with the order)
admin.retry_not_allowed: This job cannot be retried (in-flight jobs cannot go back to pending)

audits.title: Audit log
audits.subtitle: Admin action trail, newest first.
audits.note: The audit log is order-log only: one snapshot row per order. This shows the latest 100; export everything as CSV.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Devices grouped by account; unbinding requires a reason.
devices.label: Device
devices.release_title: Release "{{label}}" (wipes sessions, frees the fingerprint; next registration/login treats it as a new device)
devices.block_title: Block "{{label}}" (reversible: keeps owner and public key)

users.title: Accounts
users.subtitle: Accounts, total spent and ban state.
users.ban_action_failed: Action failed (cannot ban yourself or the last admin)

collectors.title: Collectors
collectors.subtitle: Payment collectors and report sources.
collectors.note: A collector is a printer-scoped API credential (not an account, not device-bound) that reports payments for all users of the printer.
collectors.issued_once: The plaintext token is shown only once. Copy and store it now:
collectors.label: Label

settings.title: Runtime settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime settings; some take effect as soon as they are saved.
settings.note: Changes take effect immediately without restart. Submitting an empty value resets to the built-in default. Invalid values are rejected as a whole.
settings.invalid_value: Some values are invalid; the whole change was rejected

printers.title: Printers & pricing
printers.subtitle: Printer configuration, pricing and service windows; saving takes effect immediately.
printers.name: Printer name
printers.uri_help: Direct wireless printer: ipp://printer-ip/ipp/print; CUPS gateway: ipp://gateway-ip:631/printers/queue (must include the queue)
printers.price_unit_note: Prices are per sheet in four tiers; amount = unit price × sheets per copy × copies.
printers.paper_help: Comma separated, e.g. A4,A5. Ordering is refused when no paper is configured.
printers.windows: Weekly service windows (JSON array; empty = always on)
printers.windows_help: days uses ISO weekdays (Mon=1); end earlier than start crosses midnight. Outside windows: no ordering, no release, delivery deferred.
printers.windows_bad_json: Service windows are not a valid JSON array
printers.bad_uri: The printer address must start with ipp://
printers.delete_warning: Orders, print jobs, ledger entries, payment events, verifications and collector credentials of this printer are deleted together, breaking historical reconciliation. Use "Disable" if you only want to stop it.
printers.delete_confirm: Type the printer code {{code}} to confirm:
printers.deleted_summary: Deleted: {{orders}} orders, {{jobs}} jobs, {{ledger}} ledger entries, {{events}} payment events, {{collectors}} collector credentials
